showLabel.label: Show Label
showLabel.tooltip: If checked, the container's display label will be shown on the sheet.

containerWidth.label: Width
containerWidth.tooltip: Defines the width of the container on the sheet, allowing fields to be arranged in columns.

displayLabel.label: Display Label
displayLabel.tooltip: The label for the field as it appears on the document sheet.

dataType.label: Data Type
dataType.tooltip: The type of data this field will store (e.g., text, number).

defaultValue.label: Default Value
defaultValue.tooltip: The initial value for this field.

charLimit.label: Char Limit
charLimit.tooltip: The maximum number of characters allowed for this text field.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.tooltip: Show options to define the permission levels and roles required to see/edit this field.

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.tooltip: Defines the minimum permission level on the document required to see this field.

minRoleView.label: Min. Role to View
minRoleView.tooltip: In addition to Visibility, this sets the minimum user role (e.g., Player, GM) required to see the field.

minRoleEdit.label: Min. Role to Edit
minRoleEdit.tooltip: Sets the minimum user role required to edit this field, provided they can edit the document.

minRoleEditValue.label: Min. Role to Edit Value
minRoleEditValue.tooltip: Sets the minimum user role to edit the 'Value' part of this field.

minRoleEditMax.label: Min. Role to Edit Max
minRoleEditMax.tooltip: Sets the minimum user role to edit the 'Max' part of this field.

listOptions.label: List Options (one per line)
listOptions.tooltip: Enter one option per line. The first option will be the default.

isResource.label: Set as Resource
isResource.tooltip: If checked, this field will be treated as an actor resource, available to be linked to token bars.

editableOnHUD.label: Edit on HUD
editableOnHUD.tooltip: If checked, this resource will be directly editable on the Token HUD. Uncheck to make it read-only on the HUD. This is disabled for synchronized fields.

isCounter.label: Enable Counter
isCounter.tooltip: If checked, this numeric field's value will be displayed as a counter on the item's icon in the character sheet inventory.

isFormula.label: Sync Data Paths
isFormula.tooltip: If checked, this field syncs data paths used in mathematical formulas. All data paths must be wrapped in '#' characters, e.g., #system.attributes.hp.value# + 5.

useAsPortrait.label: Use as Portrait
useAsPortrait.tooltip: If checked, this image will replace the main Actor/Item portrait. Syncs when changing the image or opening the sheet.

aspectRatio.label: Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.tooltip: Defines the display aspect ratio on the sheet.

displayAsTabs.label: Display with Tabs
displayAsTabs.tooltip: Arranges internal containers into a horizontal tab bar.

containerIcon.label: Tab Icon
containerIcon.tooltip: Image used when this container is displayed inside a tab.

mergeDown.label: Merge Down
mergeDown.tooltip: Merges this field's area with the next field in the list. This field becomes a visual reference only.

reverseLayout.label: Reverse Layout
reverseLayout.tooltip: If checked, inverts the X and/or Y axis of the Max and Value fields.

hasMacro.label: Run Macro
hasMacro.tooltip: If checked, shows a button to run a Macro.

macroRef.label: Macro's Name or UUID
macroRef.tooltip: Run that macro sending 'label', 'value', 'actor', 'uuid' and 'path' as parameters (use @ for chat macros e.g. @value).

hasMacroMax.label: Run Macro (Max)
hasMacroMax.tooltip: Habilita um botão de macro para o valor Máximo.

macroRefMax.label: Macro Max (Nome/UUID)
macroRefMax.tooltip: Macro executada pelo botão do valor Máximo.

pdfFields.title: Custom Fields: Actor PDF Fields
pdfFields.container: PDF content hidden in this editor

showNumberControls.name: Show Number Field Controls
showNumberControls.hint: Shows clickable plus and minus buttons on number fields for easier value changes.

showButtons.name: Show Buttons
showButtons.hint: Show the buttons to interact with custom fields.

actorPosition.name: Actor Fields Position
actorPosition.hint: Choose where to show the custom fields on Actor sheets.

actorAdvancedSelector.name: Advanced: Actor Fields Position
actorAdvancedSelector.hint: Enter the CSS selector for the reference element. This is for advanced users who understand CSS. For example: '.biography' or '#attributes'. The custom fields will be showed above or below this element based on your selection.

itemPosition.name: Item Fields Position
itemPosition.hint: Choose where to show the custom fields on Item sheets.

itemAdvancedSelector.name: Advanced: Item Fields Position
itemAdvancedSelector.hint: Enter the CSS selector for the reference element. This is for advanced users who understand CSS. For example: '.item-properties' or '.description'. The custom fields will be showed above or below this element based on your selection.

fullCustomMode.name: Enable Full Custom Mode
fullCustomMode.hint: When activated, this mode will hide all native elements on enabled actor and item sheets, showing only the custom fields you have configured. This is useful for creating fully customized character sheets merged with the native system sheet.

protectedSelectors.name: Full Custom Mode: Protected
protectedSelectors.hint: Enter CSS selectors, separated by commas, for elements to keep visible when Full Custom Mode is active. This is for advanced users who understand CSS.

forceActivateTabs.name: Force Activate Tabs (BETA)
forceActivateTabs.hint: When Full Custom Mode is on, Foundry's default behavior is to hide tab content. Enable this option to automatically force any protected tab (e.g., .tab[data-tab=skills]) to become active, ensuring it is visible. If disabled, you are responsible for ensuring that a protected tab is active by default.

compatibilityMode.name: Compatibility Mode (BETA)
compatibilityMode.hint: Forces the rendering of Custom Fields. If the configured fields do not appear, try enabling this option.

autoCleanup.name: Auto Cleanup Data
autoCleanup.hint: If checked, when deleting a field from config, the module will attempt to remove that field's data from all Actors/Items in the world.

autoAdjustPdf.name: Auto Adjust PDF
autoAdjustPdf.hint: If checked, PDF pages will attempt to fit the sheet window width while maintaining the correct aspect ratio (Zoom controls will still be disabled).

pdfImporter.name: Convert PDF to Actors Fields
pdfImporter.label: Convert PDF Sheet
pdfImporter.hint: Upload a fillable PDF to automatically convert fields into a replica of the PDF.
pdfImporter.keepExisting:
Keep existing pages (Append instead of Replace). 
WARNING: Not checking this will delete the currently converted PDF.

tooltips.formulaHint: Wrap data paths in '#', e.g., #system.abilities.str.mod#. Do not use '@'. Press ESC to cancel editing.
